stage1.impression: A dark slatted listening box with a pair of red acrylic monitors lit from inside and a multicoloured neon-ringed globe between them. It reads as a clean CG showroom, not a photograph. The slats repeat perfectly, the red is a flat glowing block with no light falling on its faces, no practical explains the light, the plinths and floor sink into mud, and there is no sign of life. A magazine would see a generic slat-wall bar render. It does not yet read as a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: Speakers read as the lit hero: their faces lit from outside by a visible pool, speaker region lum_median >= 45, with real acrylic edge highlights rather than a uniform internal glow
Light falls the way practicals throw it: pools on plinths and floor brighter than the upper slat wall, not an even wash that brightens toward the ceiling
Signs of life: the card's few motion-blurred listeners in the lounge chairs, plus a glass and a record out of its sleeve
Oak slats and end-grain floor show real timber variation at 1:1 (tone per slat, block grid, checks), with no perfect CG repetition
Red held in gamut: the Ember acrylic shows hue and tonal gradation, not a single clipped primary red (G channel near zero)
A composed frame with no dead foreground: the empty rug and the cropped blurred chair back at the bottom edge removed
Some atmosphere: a hint of haze in the spot cones so the pools of light read as light in air

defects.what: Right speaker: flat saturated red (median RGB 64/3/1), lum_median 18, 1.35% clipped inside while the front faces stay dark. Reads as a lit sign, not cast acrylic
Left speaker: same flat internal glow, 1.76% clipped, lum_median 26
Waveguide tops show wobbly, distorted stripe reflections of the slats that read as plastic

Upper slat wall is the brightest surface in the room (median 39.6) while floor and plinths sit at 8 to 16. The vertical profile runs 36 to 46 at the top and falls to 11 at the bottom, upside down for downlit pools
Slats perfectly regular in spacing, tone and sheen. Obvious CG repetition
Right plinth crushed: lum_median 8.2, crush 17.5%. The terrazzo is barely legible
Left plinth dark (median 11). No light pool on its top apart from the red spill
Floor and rug are a smooth featureless brown. The end-grain floor and Mother's coloured shadow are not readable
Cropped, blurred oak chair back along the bottom edge. Awkward foreground
Lounge chairs empty. No glass, no record, no people. The card asks for listeners and the frame has 0 figures
Mother EARF's rims read as neon tubes. The tinted discs between the rims are almost invisible, so she reads as a light sculpture rather than acrylic

changes.problem: The speakers are not lit from outside, so their faces are dark and only the internal glow reads.

evidence.measured: right speaker region lum_median 18.1, p95 156, clip 1.35%; left 26.4

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spots
change.to: 2 x 85 W, 30 deg, 2700 K, aimed at the woofer centre from above and in front so the pool covers the front face and spills onto the plinth top

changes.expected: Front baffles and woofer surrounds legible, with soft falloff onto the plinth. Speaker median about 45 to 60.

changes.problem: The Ember red is pushed to a pure primary with the green channel near zero, so the acrylic has no hue gradation and reads as signage.

evidence.measured: median RGB 64/3/1; delta E2000 24 from a warm ember #B0301E

change.to: AgX - Base Contrast, white_balance_k 3500 K (keep exposure, re-check after c1)

changes.expected: Ember shows orange-red to deep red gradation through thickness. Green channel in the speaker rises above about 10.

changes.problem: The light is upside down: the upper slat wall is the brightest surface, and floor and plinths sink.

evidence.measured: y-profile bins 36, 46, 45, 38, 28, 19, 15, 11; upper wall median 39.6 vs floor 16.0

change.setting: inside the lantern: fill and trap areas
change.to: fill 0.035 W/m2, trap 0.05 W/m2 (let the spots carry the room)

changes.expected: Upper wall drops to a quiet background (median 25 to 32), so the pools below read brighter than the wall above.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's plinth and the floor under her are dark, so her coloured shadow on the end-grain floor, which the card asks for, does not read.

evidence.measured: Mother's plinth median 10.5; floor 300-1200 x 640-800 median 16.0, p95 56

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF spot
change.to: 1 x 95 W, 26 deg, 2700 K, aimed steeply down through the globe so the disc shadows land on the floor in front of the plinth

changes.expected: A visible tinted pool and shadow on the floor before her plinth, with the plinth top lit.

changes.problem: The room is empty: no listeners, glasses or records, so it reads as a showroom, not a bar.

evidence.measured: people: 0 figures; lounge chairs empty; no props anywhere in frame

change.to: 2 to 3 seated listeners in the lounge chairs, backs or three-quarter-back to camera, motion-blurred (shutter about 1/8 s); a tumbler on a chair arm or side table; a record sleeve leaning on the left plinth

changes.expected: The frame reads as a lived-in night with people listening.

changes.problem: Oak slats and the end-grain floor are perfectly uniform, the strongest CG tell in the frame.

evidence.measured: visual: identical slat tone, spacing and sheen across the whole wall; floor a smooth brown with no block grid (p95 56)

change.from: single uniform oak tone, uniform floor
change.to: per-slat random tone ±10% and roughness ±0.1, faint grain; end-grain floor with visible 60 to 90 mm block grid, varied ring tone and darker joints

changes.expected: Timber reads at real scale at 1:1, and the floor picks up highlights from the pools.

changes.problem: The bottom fifth is dead rug plus a cropped, blurred chair back, and the hero pair sits small at the far end.

evidence.measured: visual: empty rug and a blurred chair-back fragment at 270-600 x 720-800

change.to: lens 38 mm, camera z 1.15, target lowered about 5 cm so the plinths sit near the bottom third and the chair back leaves the frame (or reads fully as a soft foreground shoulder); keep verticals true

changes.expected: The speakers and globe fill more of the frame, with one readable foreground layer of listeners.

changes.problem: There is no atmosphere, so the spots read as computed pools rather than light in a room.

evidence.measured: visual: no cone or veil visible in the dark gaps between speakers and globe

changes.expected: A faint visible veil in the spot cones, with blacks lifted slightly in the gaps.

out_of_scope.request: Mother EARF's rims in four saturated colours (blue, green, pink, yellow) break the room's 'one colour' rule and compete with the Ember pair as hero
out_of_scope.why: She is an EARF product placed as fixed. Her tints and glowing rims cannot be changed here. The owner would need to decide whether she belongs in a frame meant for the Tropos pair.

out_of_scope.request: The waveguide tops' distorted stripe reflections read as plastic
out_of_scope.why: The waveguide's shape is the speaker's own geometry. Only the reflected environment could be calmed, which c6's slat variation partly does.

out_of_scope.request: The slat wall makes the room generic (a stock acoustic-panel look)
out_of_scope.why: The oak slat walls are the fixed architecture of the lantern.
